method: Complete current-snapshot static audit of the exact 175-file assigned partition. Fresh raw-byte SHA256 and executable-bit verification, OXC parsing of all 173 TS/MJS files, production declarations/guards/routes/imports/schema extraction and all 92 test-code assertion/control-flow scans cover every assigned file. The 164 files unchanged from audit9 retain their earlier same-checkout semantic analysis, supplemented by current critical-path manual review; this does not claim all unchanged lines were manually reread. The ten initial changed/new files were reviewed for rename atomicity, delivery/receipt semantics, bounded manager helper serialization, first-turn history recovery and official reasoning-summary protocol tests. One final runtime README clarification was then manually checked against current launcher/sudo contracts. Initial ab925 frozen facts are retained, and the final two-document-only amendment was independently reconciled across all 1947 manifest entries before sealing. Current cross-layer UI ownership, durable original-ID recovery, bounded history retry and public-summary/progress terminal behavior have separate independent reviews whose primary file hashes still match. No tests, source edits, network, browser, SSH, live requests or service actions were performed during this audit. The reviewer authored the rename and manager changes before the freeze; that author relationship is explicit and manager changes also have a separate independent reviewer report. This report is neither a claim of independence from authorship for those files nor a substitute for the team independent review and full-CI gate.
hashAlgorithm: SHA256 of raw file bytes; executable bits recorded separately

coverage.staticCountBoundary: Extracted suite/test definitions and assertions are structural counts, not executed or distinct test-case totals.
coverage.retainedPriorSemanticCoverage: Unchanged raw hashes and executable bits retain audit9 and earlier same-checkout production/test/documentation semantic review. Fresh structure and critical-flow manual review are applied to the complete current partition. Existing test source is reviewed as source; old test passes are not relabelled as newly executed tests or current hosted CI.

freshManualFocusedReviews.focus: All rename diff and adjacent reserve/replay/dispatch/settle/recover/transaction code: strict id/name-only registered-label edit, stable ID/path and no native worker or filesystem mutation, Unicode/control/length validation, authorization and maintenance guards, matching original-ID receipt replay, durable not_found, atomic label+accepted receipt commit, proven rollback returns not_sent only when original receipt is still pending, retained unknown on uncertain cases, minimal result projection. New regression bodies retain rollback/capacity/restart/replay/revocation/maintenance assertions.

One instance client serializes all root reads and writes, enqueue-based monotonic 120-second deadline and bounded 32 requests/8 MiB payload; actual stdin boundary repeats authorization. Queued failures are not_sent, sent failures remain unknown. Timeout/pipe/spawn failure settles once and no live child releases the serial slot before close. Original mutation is never retransmitted; real external lock busy remains visible. Local exclusive-file subprocess test is not Linux systemd/flock acceptance.

Fresh history identity/turnRevision/unknown fence, same-ID known-live projection, exact legal terminal notification priority, streaming deltas do not stale a traversal, cold interrupted preserved. Read crossing first accepted turn refuses old proof; fresh read recovers with one native turn/start and no implicit resume. Early completion before accept and lifecycle cache invalidation remain covered by retained deterministic regression analysis.

Official summary notification schemas and identity/indexed public summary pass through the runtime/worker/gateway without synthesizing summary from raw reasoning. Unified history preserves native summary separately from raw content. Omitted summary settings preserve native defaults and explicit none is passed unchanged. New tests use offline native substitutes and real service/dispatcher/reducer code, not commercial inference.

Positive provider registry/default fallback, provider aliases and selected account/catalog pagination; project registration versus native project identity, native-UID resolution/create, defaults probe cache/config/options/cwd identity and owned cleanup, terminal/connection admission. Administrator login version revalidation, session/CSRF/logout revocation and durable original-operation recovery remain intact.

CLI exit retains barrier until proven subtree cleanup, requests one fresh runtime, flushes definitive RPC reply before restart exit75, and reports unknown on failed cleanup. Worker reconnection/event-channel ownership rejects stale browser leases and never silently replays a mutation.

Separate pre-freeze independent reviews and current primary hash revalidation cover same-auth save owner surviving its own maintenance, separately expiring unsubmitted consent, explicit post-save read recovery, shared settings/sidebar draft guards and frozen-target original-operation recovery, bounded typed-stale history recovery with no resume, public-summary-only rendering and known MCP final snapshot/progress precedence. Cross-scope files are supplementary, not counted in this disjoint owned partition.

Final documentation-only amendment describes fixed catalog-server allowlist mode separately from generic native-launch path. Current default sudo permits the fixed catalog-server verb; runtime catalog initialization is not described as arbitrary command authorization. Initialization/service identities and token stdout private channel boundary remain unchanged.

authorshipBoundary.rename: Root separately inspected the final transaction/receipt and rollback behavior before freeze; no unrelated older project/create review is presented as an independent rename review.

finalDocumentationAmendment.description: A missing exact catalog-server launcher/sudo mode description was corrected in two existing README files. Production and tests remain byte-identical to the initial audit10 freeze; no tests were executed or new audit round invented.

upgradeContract.failure: Stop at a failed step and use its recorded recovery before proceeding.
upgradeContract.retainedCrossScopeEvidence: Current strict final verify, context-bound retained legacy restoration and management-lock policies remain unchanged from audit9. Local registered project rename does not rename native directories or projects.
upgradeContract.finalAcceptance: Historical CI9/deployment a075 validates only source e017. The current source requires its separately authorized full CI, exact-candidate deployment and acceptance; no earlier case count or live result is reused.

unexecutedIntegrations: No full or targeted tests were executed during audit10. Linked author and independent-review results predate this audit and keep their original scopes.
No live administrator/provider login, browser, model inference, external MCP, SSH, deployment or main-service action in this audit.

The prior live provider screenshot did not capture the exact competing helper pair; recorded writes completed and no persistent lock holder was observed. The queue and same-auth UI fixes have deterministic local regressions, not a claim of reproduced online transaction failure.
Real provider generation of reasoning summaries and live deployment of the current UI/backend changes remain outside this static audit.
Original hosted CI3 interruption cause was not reconstructed from exact runner trace; established history/live consistency defects and deterministic regressions remain separately documented.
